features.name: single car tyre
features.notes: At the top of the mountain path
features.quote: A single car tyre is at the top of a winding mountain path.

features.name: winding mountain path
features.notes: Descending from the top toward the bottom with visible twists and turns
features.quote: The tyre rolls down the path picking up speed as it goes.

features.name: mountain terrain relief
features.notes: Natural elevated landforms shaping the route
features.quote: Terrain Relief: Natural landform shaping the ground: hills, mountains, cliffs, a valley, or a canyon.

features.name: continuous path corridor
features.notes: Wide lateral corridor with no discrete lane slots
features.quote: Free Lateral Steering: Continuous lateral movement across a corridor instead of discrete lane slots.

features.name: pathside run ending hazard
features.notes: Placed where contact or leaving the route is visually dangerous
features.quote: Run-Ending Hazard: Whatever ends the run on contact — a train, a pit, a pursuing threat.

features.name: steep path edges
features.notes: Clear off-path boundaries along the mountain route
features.quote: If the tyre goes off the path you lose and have to start again from the top.

features.name: downhill route endpoint
features.notes: Visible bottom destination of the descending path
features.quote: The objective is to get to the bottom against the clock.
